column1: # Committed go.dev/tour corpus — exact executable sources + upstream LICENSE.
# The corpus tree vendors the EXECUTABLE DENOMINATOR of the pinned inventory
# build_only_go_program row) plus the upstream LICENSE. Files are copied
# verbatim from the pinned module materialization (see docs/tour/pin.tsv) at
# their upstream _content/tour paths. Excluded fragments (nobuild skeletons),
# article inline prose, and static web assets are NOT vendored.
# Per-source bytes and SHA-256 live in the inventory rows themselves, which
# docs/tour/pin.tsv freezes with inventory_data_sha256; this table pins only
# what that join cannot: the corpus root, the LICENSE digest, and the file
